crossRefs.note: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
